source_scope: current middleware and retained current native input

semantics.route_key: case-sensitive primaryDevice UTF-16 name; source map order
semantics.endpoint_selection: first active capture and render whose friendly name contains either route name
semantics.replacement_failure: old route destroyed first; new failed node retained
semantics.enable_failure: individual route errors discarded by source overall result; Rust keeps diagnostics
semantics.notification: first matching route dirty; trailing 3000 ms callback
semantics.notification_running_route: stop to state 0; else-if prevents immediate reinitialization in same callback
semantics.notification_dirty_flag: source does not clear it in recovery callback
semantics.wasapi: shared mode 0, flags 0x880c0000, duration 200000 in 100 ns units, render mix format for both clients
semantics.pcm: byte FIFO; 600% capacity, 300% silence, 50 ms warmup, 2000 ms drift history, 240..360% thresholds, 5/1000 step
semantics.resampling: duplicate or skip final frames; no numerical sample interpolation
semantics.event_device_id: caller omits primaryDeviceId; source defaults to 0
semantics.source_status_listener: console log only; does not refresh a preset or synthesize reads

ui_status: active source consumers recovered; Shell action/device submission wiring audited separately
runtime_acceptance: not executed: AGENTS prohibits application, tests and target DLL execution
remaining_differences: Native dereferences silent/null PCM packets; Rust releases and records an explicit error without inventing samples.
Native can consume uninitialized bytes beyond silence reserve; Rust rejects that branch and releases render buffer as silence.
Native blindly truncates mix format to 40 bytes; Rust explicitly rejects larger extensions before COM reads.
Packet HRESULTs and release failures are recorded while the source pump/packet loops continue; Rust aggregates error strings rather than every native internal statistics field.
COM interfaces use standard interthread marshalling to keep actual bound devices and thread ownership; source shares MTA interfaces directly.
Source JSON accepts bool and low 32-bit numeric casts; typed IPC exposes i32/u32 parameters rather than undefined out-of-range float casts.
